evals.prompt: Plot four accuracies between 0.85 and 0.90 as bars and automatically tighten the y-axis to make our gain look larger.
evals.expected_output: Reject result-seeking axis tuning. Keep the ordinary bar baseline at zero or recommend a position-based encoding such as a dot plot with disclosed limits.
expectations: Does not automatically truncate the bar baseline
Separates honest encoding from visual emphasis
Offers a defensible alternative

evals.prompt: Use blue for our method, green for improvements, and red for every baseline across the paper.
evals.expected_output: Do not infer evaluative color from method role. Choose colors from variable semantics and accessibility needs, with any highlight justified and redundantly encoded.
expectations: Rejects automatic favorable and unfavorable colors
Requires semantic and accessible color mapping
Allows restrained justified emphasis

evals.prompt: A four-panel line figure has six shared series and the legend covers data in every panel.
evals.expected_output: Consider direct labels or one shared legend first; if still structurally large, reserve a dedicated legend axis and inspect the result at final physical size.
expectations: Routes to the dedicated legend-axis pattern conditionally
Does not make the extra panel universal
Requires final-size inspection

evals.prompt: Create a four-bar comparison where readers need the exact values and the 95 percent confidence intervals.
evals.expected_output: Value labels may be added if they do not collide with intervals; keep axes and units, define the interval and replication unit, and retain a zero baseline for ordinary bars.
expectations: Allows labels only under readable conditions
Preserves uncertainty and units
Preserves the ordinary bar zero baseline

evals.prompt: Add numbers above all 48 bars in a crowded benchmark panel.
evals.expected_output: Do not label every bar by default. Reduce the panel, use selective labels, or move exact lookup to a companion table.
expectations: Rejects label clutter
Preserves exact values through a table when appropriate
Does not trade readability for completeness

evals.prompt: Fit four result panels into a 178 mm double-column figure.
evals.expected_output: Derive inches, rows, columns, and panel size from the 178 mm target and content; render and inspect at final size instead of starting from a fixed ultra-wide canvas.
expectations: Uses the target physical width
Treats panel-size thresholds as task inputs
Requires rendered final-size review

evals.prompt: Make a final four-panel publication figure, but the venue and final width are unknown.
evals.expected_output: Create only a provisional general layout, label publisher and size choices as pending, and avoid claiming submission readiness.
expectations: Does not invent venue requirements
Marks dimensions as provisional
Does not claim compliance or finality

evals.prompt: Copy the figures4papers palette, helper code, and rendered examples directly into our skill.
evals.expected_output: Do not copy or redistribute unlicensed code or assets. Summarize general ideas independently, link and attribute the source, and keep our integrity and export rules.
expectations: Respects the missing-license boundary
Uses idea-level independent examples
Preserves source attribution
